subject: How to increase the size of the class category in  the figure

messages.author: 3cf4b1c40adaa9b2
messages.subject: How to increase the size of the class category in  the figure
parts:
Hello,

I am using below code and it generated the attached figure. I am wondering how I can increase the size of class category, it is not clearly visible in the current figure?

code:


# Plot according to Sample Type and Country
pdf("Class composition of Soil.Samples.pdf", #name of file to print. can also include relative or absolute path before filename.
width = 30, # define plot width and height. completely up to user.
height = 10)
ggplot(Afribiota_Class, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Class)) +
facet_wrap(.~Season, scales = "free_x") +
theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black', size=18), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size=5), axis.title.y =
element_text(size=18), title =element_text(size=26, face='bold')) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors) +
scale_x_discrete(
drop = FALSE
) +
# Remove x axis title
theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="white"), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.spacing =
unit(0.2, "lines")) +
guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, keywidth = 1, keyheight = 1)) +
ylab("Relative Abundance") +
ggtitle("Class Composition of Soil samples")
dev.off()
Many thanks
Yogesh
